propositions: push_recovery's _recover_dirty_merge aborts when an untracked local file collides with a file the remote merge wants to create, leaving the colliding untracked file in the worktree on every retry
the untracked-overwrite collision class (compaction leftovers like *-SNAPSHOT.json and *.retired) that wedges push_recovery is the same class already recovered by sync.py's reconverge path
_recover_dirty_merge must parse merge-abort-named paths, quarantine the named untracked colliding files, and retry the merge once before giving up
stash restore ordering must be preserved: the quarantine and retry must occur between the failed merge and the stash restore, restoring the stash commit exactly once on all exit paths
genuine merge conflicts and unnamed paths must retain today's abort-and-restore behavior unchanged
